description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/calc-admission: TableDefs.Item('N<i>') raised 3265 right after the CREATE TABLE on a stale TableDefs collection, so no calculated column N1 to N16 was ever appended and table-side admission was tested only for N0 = Now(). In a new ACCDB with T(ID COUNTER primary key, A LONG, S TEXT(30)) and one row (A = 10, S = 'abc'): for each of seventeen expressions (Now, Date, Rnd, DLookup, DCount, Eval, Len, Switch, a cross-table reference, an undefined function, a self reference, CLng of text, division by zero, Long overflow, Format, Mid, IIf with Null) a new table N<i>(ID, A, S) gets a calculated field X with the expression through CreateField, Field.Expression and Fields.Append, with TableDefs refreshed before the lookup and DBEngine.Errors right before and after the append; then INSERT (A=3, S='abc') and its rows are read; and the same expression is run as a SELECT over T as a query.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(30))
CREATE TABLE N0 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N0 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Now() AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N1 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N1 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Date() AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N2 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N2 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Rnd() AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N3 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N3 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT DLookup("A","T","ID=1") AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N4 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N4 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT DCount("*","T") AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N5 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N5 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Eval("1+1") AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N6 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N6 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Len([S]) AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N7 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N7 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Switch([A]>1,"big",True,"small") AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N8 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N8 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT [T].[A] AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N9 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N9 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT NoSuchFunction([A]) AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N10 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N10 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT [X]+1 AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N11 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N11 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT CLng([S]) AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N12 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N12 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT [A]/0 AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N13 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N13 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT [A]*2147483647 AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N14 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N14 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Format([A],"000") AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N15 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N15 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT Mid([S],2,1) AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
CREATE TABLE N16 (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_N16 PRIMARY KEY, A LONG, S TEXT(20))
SELECT IIf([A]>1,[A],Null) AS X FROM T WHERE ID = 1
